d: 🌟 We're Hiring: Assistant Accountant / Accounts Executive / Finance Executive

We are a finance-focused organization supporting businesses through reliable accounting practices, financial reporting, and effective financial management. Our approach emphasizes accuracy, transparency, and sound financial controls to help organizations maintain financial stability and make informed business decisions. We value professionals who combine strong accounting knowledge with analytical thinking and a commitment to maintaining high standards in financial operations.

We are looking for a capable Assistant Accountant / Accounts Executive / Finance Executive to support accounting operations and contribute to effective financial management. This part-time remote opportunity involves coordinating financial records, monitoring transactions, supporting reporting activities, and maintaining accurate accounting documentation. You will work with relevant stakeholders to ensure financial processes run efficiently while supporting the organization's wider financial objectives.
Maintain accurate financial records, general ledgers, and accounting documentation.
Coordinate accounts payable and accounts receivable activities.
Review invoices, payment records, expenses, and supporting financial documents.
Assist with monthly financial reporting and account reconciliation.
Monitor outstanding payments, receivables, and routine financial transactions.
Perform bank reconciliations and investigate accounting discrepancies.
Support budgeting, cash flow monitoring, and financial data analysis.
Coordinate with internal departments regarding accounting and payment matters.
Maintain organized financial records and support audit preparation activities.
Identify opportunities to improve accounting procedures and financial reporting accuracy.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred.
Minimum of 3+ years of relevant professional experience preferred.
Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial procedures.
Knowledge of general ledger, accounts payable, and accounts receivable processes.
Familiarity with bank reconciliation and financial reporting activities.
Proficiency in spreadsheets and general accounting software.
Ability to analyze financial information and identify discrepancies.
Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage deadlines, maintain confidentiality, and work independently in a remote environment.
Flexible part-time working hours with a fully remote arrangement.
Competitive compensation based on experience and financial expertise.
Opportunities to contribute to financial reporting and accounting improvement initiatives.
Exposure to diverse financial operations and international business activities.
Professional growth through involvement in accounting, budgeting, and financial analysis.
A supportive working environment that values accuracy, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Analyze the behavior of the plants with respect to the set point and setting up the various control parameters
Perform daily auditing of plant performance by utilizing the facilities built on the building management system (BMS) e.g. data logging/ plant review/ alarm manager status/ etc.
Analyze reasons of failure of plants and provides specific diagnostic/ problem analysis and specify the necessary remedial actions for Supervisor 's approval

Use the historical logged data of various plants to review the system and propose improvements in order to enhance the system efficiency and or reduce the operation cost as well as improve the services provided to customer
Program the BMS and PPM system and other plants (e.g. standby power generator/ diesel driven fire fighting pump/ fire alarm system/ etc.) for automatic periodic testing.

A proven knowledge in the operation and maintenance of the equipment. A good command of English and the ability to find fault and rectify subsystems are essentials.

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out. Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
